game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Bone Crypt Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Shadow Cave – Bone Crypt, a dusty bone crypt: the torchbearer must handle slime blobs while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bone Crypt: a dusty bone crypt
core_gameplay_loop: In Bone Crypt, repeat each round: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor. Each round, a new glowing mushrooms challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the dungeon_clear value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 380 points of glowing mushrooms by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 380, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Nested While Dungeon
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested While Dungeon' (Week 4 slot 15), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Bone Crypt'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how dungeon_clear changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against slime blobs in Bone Crypt.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 380 within 51 seconds.
